english.title: Do an act to prevent fish passing through fish pass
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY..), whereby salmon, or trout were in any way liable to be scared, hindered or prevented from passing through a fish pass.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(1) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.

english.notes:
(i) The owner or occupier of a dam shall be deemed to have altered it if it is damaged, destroyed or allowed to fall into a state of disrepair, and if after notice is served on him by the water authority, he fails to repair or reconstruct it within a reasonable time so as to render the fish pass as efficient as before the damage or destruction.
(ii) This section shall not apply to a temporary bridge or board used for crossing a free gap, and taken away immediately after the person using it has crossed.
(iii) In addition to any fine imposed the defendant shall also in every case pay any expenses which may be incurred in restoring the fish pass to its former state of efficiency. Any such expenses may be recovered in a summary manner.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.
